text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish prime minister opposes any U.S. military action against Iraq.
- Iraq is invited to attend an oil conference to be held in London.
- CIA admits the strong position of President Saddam Hussein.
- Iraq's ambassador in Ankara reiterates Iraq's rejection of the security zone Turkey wants to set up in northern Iraq.
- France encourages dialogue between Baghdad government and the Kurds.
- More than four million students go to Iraqi schools on Saturday after the end of the summer holiday.
- Activities of Babylon cultural festival start on Sunday.
